name: gathers each batch independently and fills padding
input: two batches, two features, and one padded selection
test:
import numpy as np
values = np.array([[[10, 11], [20, 21]], [[100, 101], [200, 201]]])
indices = np.array([[1, 0], [0, -1]])
gathered, valid = masked_batched_gather(values, indices, fill_value=-5)
assert np.array_equal(gathered, np.array([[[20, 21], [10, 11]], [[100, 101], [-5, -5]]]))
assert np.array_equal(valid, np.array([[True, True], [True, False]]))
assert valid.dtype == np.bool_

name: uses a compatible output dtype without aliasing input
input: integer values and a fractional fill value
test:
import numpy as np
values = np.array([[[1], [2]]], dtype=np.int64)
indices = np.array([[-1, 1]], dtype=np.int64)
gathered, valid = masked_batched_gather(values, indices, fill_value=0.5)
assert gathered.dtype == np.float64
assert np.array_equal(gathered, np.array([[[0.5], [2.0]]]))
gathered[0, 1, 0] = 99
assert values[0, 1, 0] == 2 and valid.tolist() == [[False, True]]

name: rejects invalid array shapes and indexes
input: wrong ranks, mismatched batches, booleans, and out-of-range values
test:
import numpy as np
def must_raise(call):
    try:
        call()
    except ValueError:
        return
    raise AssertionError('expected ValueError')
values = np.zeros((2, 3, 1))
must_raise(lambda: masked_batched_gather(np.zeros((2, 3)), np.zeros((2, 1), dtype=int)))
must_raise(lambda: masked_batched_gather(values, np.zeros((1, 1), dtype=int)))
must_raise(lambda: masked_batched_gather(values, np.array([[True], [False]])))
must_raise(lambda: masked_batched_gather(values, np.array([[3], [0]])))
must_raise(lambda: masked_batched_gather(values, np.array([[-2], [0]])))
